subAgentsView.title: Sub-agents
subAgentsView.description: Roles and personas, per-role model selection, guardrails, delegated tasks and measured cost — all in one dedicated place.

subAgents.title: Sub-agents
subAgents.description: Choose which model profile the multi-agent swarm uses for its sub-agents, and tune execution guardrails.
subAgents.distinct: Use a distinct model profile for sub-agents (otherwise they inherit the active profile)
subAgents.profileDescription: Models the swarm's sub-agents run on — inherited by default, distinct when you pin one.
subAgents.guardrailsDescription: Bounds applied to every swarm sub-agent.
subAgents.fallbackPolicy: Fallback is automatic: if a configured sub-agent model fails (rate limit, timeout, provider error), the task retries exactly once on the active profile and the result notes it. Not configurable by design.
subAgents.delegationDescription: Settings for background delegations — separate from the swarm's per-role profiles.
subAgents.costDescription: What multi-agent execution really costs, measured.
subAgents.costMeasured: Measured: a 4-task swarm took 452s vs 33s for the same task done directly (≈13x slower). Swarm also multiplies token cost: every sub-agent gets its own copy of the upstream context (capped).
subAgents.costWhenToUse: Reserve the swarm for genuinely complex, multi-disciplinary work. Simple tasks: the main agent acts directly — faster and cheaper.
subAgents.tokensUnavailable: Token counts unavailable on the current provider (gateway reports no usage) — duration stays measured.
subAgents.noSwarmRunYet: No swarm has been executed yet in this installation.
subAgents.crossVerificationNever: Cross-verification has never been enabled — every swarm so far ran on the standard path (no extra model call).
subAgents.crossVerificationMeasured: Cross-verification (opt-in) ran on {{swarms}} swarm(s) and added {{calls}} model call(s) in total — about {{perSwarm}} per run. Swarms without the flag add 0.
subAgents.teammateNever: Team mode has never been enabled — sub-agents could not ask a teammate, so no swarm spent an extra model call on it.
subAgents.teammateMeasured: Team mode (opt-in) ran on {{swarms}} swarm(s) and teammate questions added {{calls}} model call(s) in total — about {{perSwarm}} per run. An unanswered or timed-out question costs 0.
subAgents.saveScopeHint: Save applies to the profile and guardrails sections above; delegated-task settings save instantly.
subAgents.systemPromptPlaceholder: Role instructions — added on top of project/agent instructions
subAgents.openjevDescription: A lightweight 'System One' decision call evaluates each request before generation and injects an advisory routing hint. Off by default; never blocking (the hint is skipped if the server is unreachable).
subAgents.openjevHint: Default local server: http://127.0.0.1:8080 (POST /v1/systemone). Every decision is logged (prompt → verdict → injected).
